purpose: Teach: チャイナ/ウエスト/浦和/三島/ジェフ/クラーク/コロンビア/セントラル

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがチャイナドレスの絵本を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad showed you that picture book about the cheongsam, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm observation, a little indulgent. Soft recognition of something small that mattered. Slight smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとウエスト測定したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I measured my waist!
lines.style: Bright and immediate, almost bursting with it. No hesitation. The excitement of inclusion, of being measured like a grown-up.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが浦和レッズのジャージを下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father brought you that Urawa Reds jersey.
lines.style: Gently noting it, the way she notes everything. Quiet awareness — she sees what these small gifts mean. Slight trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと三島由紀夫の小説の表紙見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at the cover of a Mishima novel!
lines.style: Rush of excitement, unfiltered. He's sharing something he knows is a little grown-up, a little strange. Proud of it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがジェフ・ベックのCDをお買いになったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father purchased a Jeff Beck CD.
lines.style: Understated acknowledgment. She's cataloguing his father's particular taste, his way of showing up. No judgment — just witnessing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとクラーク博士の絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I saw the picture book about Dr. Clark!
lines.style: Breathless almost. He's collecting these moments, these names, these things Dad shares. The pride of having been chosen.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがコロンビア出張のお話して下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, your father told you about his trip to Colombia.
lines.style: Softly cataloguing. There's a slight pause before the name, like she's holding space for what that trip means to him. Resigned affection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとセントラルクーラーのお話したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I talked about central air conditioning!
lines.style: Unguarded and warm. The comfort of ordinary conversation with his dad. Finality — he's satisfied by this simple exchange.
